title: Vishal Chawla v. Purvanchal Vidhut Vitrana Nigam Ltd., Varanasi and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai, J. and Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; petitioner left to Clause 6.5.
headnote: Writ disputing an electricity bill, for non-payment of which a recovery citation had issued, dismissed because the petitioner may take recourse to Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: Vishal Chawla filed Writ-C No. 27409 of 2023 in the Allahabad High Court against Purvanchal Vidhut Vitrana Nigam Ltd., Varanasi, disputing an electricity bill for which a recovery citation had been issued. None appeared to press the petition on 12 September 2023, and it was adjourned, then listed again on 18 October 2023. On 27 October 2023 the Court directed that the recovery certificate not be pressed. On 8 November 2023 that interim order was extended while the licensee's counsel sought further time for instructions.

holding_units.topic: disputed bill and recovery citation — alternate remedy
holding_units.holding: Where the petitioner disputes the electricity bill for non-payment of which a recovery citation has been issued, the petitioner may take recourse to Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and the writ is dismissed in view of that alternative remedy.

principle_tags.application: The Division Bench dismissed the writ on the ground that Clause 6.5 was an available alternative remedy for the consumer who disputed the electricity bill underlying the recovery citation.
The dispute before the Court was the electricity bill itself, and Clause 6.5 was treated as the remedy for that dispute.

not_decided.point: Whether the disputed electricity bill and the recovery citation were correct
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the bill and left the petitioner to Clause 6.5.
